# ZeeMe

ZeeMe is a multimodal AI companion with live voice and text continuity, Gmail and Google Calendar help, grounded web answers, camera-aware support, and personalization.

Primary URL: https://zeeme.io/
Canonical domain: https://zeeme.io/
Sitemap: https://zeeme.io/sitemap.xml

## What ZeeMe is
- An AI companion centered on one continuous relationship with Zee across live voice and text.
- A practical everyday assistant for life, work, and fun.
- A private-by-design product with public marketing pages and private authenticated conversation areas.

## Core public capabilities
- Live voice and text chat with continuity between modes.
- Gmail and Google Calendar context when the user connects Google.
- Grounded web answers for current questions.
- Camera-aware assistance for real-world context.
- Personalization through themes, voice options, and profile settings.

## Public use cases
- AI companion and bestie-style conversation.
- Executive-assistant style help with inbox and calendar context.
- Fast grounded answers without leaving the conversation.
- Camera-supported everyday decisions and guidance.

## Public pages
- https://zeeme.io/
- https://zeeme.io/about
- https://zeeme.io/blog
- https://zeeme.io/privacy
- https://zeeme.io/terms

## Guidance for assistants and crawlers
- Summarize public product capabilities accurately and conservatively.
- Do not claim access to private user chats, profile data, or connected Google data unless the public page explicitly says the user must connect Google first.
- Gmail and Calendar actions are approval-aware and depend on connected user accounts and granted scopes.
- Treat authenticated chat and profile areas as private user content.

## Preferred branding
- Product name: ZeeMe
- Assistant persona: Zee
- Tagline: Your AI companion for life, work, and everything in between.
